resources.string: This tool is in development and will be available soon
Add images from the gallery to turn them into one PDF file
Each page in its own file
Separate files with a semicolon, e.g. 1-3; 4-6; 7
Recompresses the images inside the file. Text-only files may not get much smaller.
Choose a file to see the preview
Preview of the first page only
Save properties to a new copy
Asked for when opening the file. Leave empty to allow opening without a password.
Asked for to change the permissions below or remove the protection.
Creates a new copy of the file without encryption or restrictions.
Turns form fields into fixed content while keeping text quality and search
Turns every page into an image; comments, forms and links become part of the page and can no longer be edited
No text was found in this file. If it is scanned, try the text recognition (OCR) tool.
The page is loaded and saved as a PDF with A4 pages. Needs an internet connection.
Supports Arabic and English text with automatic line wrapping.
Creates a Word file with the text only (no images or complex formatting).
Choose a PDF file, then tap Print to open the system print dialog, where you can pick a printer or save as a file.
Choose a file and it opens in the reader with the read-aloud bar at the bottom. You can change the speed and stop at any time.
Not connected to Wi-Fi. Connect to a network and try again.
Share your files with a computer without a cable: start the server, then open the address in a browser on a computer on the same network to download files or upload new files to the phone.
Note: any device on the same network can reach the files while the server is running. Stop it when you are done.
A complete offline Arabic PDF editor: read, annotate, edit pages, sign, convert and protect your files in one place.
Continuous scroll or single page, night mode, text search, table of contents and bookmarks, and read aloud.
Highlight, underline, notes, pen drawing, shapes, stamps, and inserting text and images on pages.
Merge, split, rotate, delete, reorder, extract pages, page numbers, watermark and size reduction.
Images, text and web pages to PDF, and PDF to images, Word, HTML and text.
Scan documents with the camera with automatic cropping, and turn scanned images into searchable Arabic and English text.
Passwords and permissions, removing protection, permanent redaction, flattening, and hand-drawn or certificate-based digital signatures.
Fill form fields, save your details to fill forms quickly, and export the data.
Summaries, explanations, translations and review questions about the document, using your own API key.
Move files between your phone and a computer through the browser on the same Wi-Fi network, without a cable.
All files are processed on your device and are not sent to any server, except for the AI assistant and web page conversion, which need the internet.
